newsitem.title: USA: Sunbelt's modified note pact terminated.
newsitem.headline: Sunbelt's modified note pact terminated.

text.p: Sunbelt Nursery Group Inc said Wednesday its note modification agreement with Pier 1 Imports has been terminated.
It said the agreement would have allowed it to pay $2 million in cash, stock and notes by May 31, 1997 to discharge an $8 million note due to Pier 1.
The terms were part of a settlement agreement the two companies entered into in July 1995, it said.
With the termination, original terms of the settlement agreement will apply, it said.

The terms provide that payments on the note are only required if Sunbelt achieves certain cash flow and profitability levels, it said. It said it has not yet been required to make any payments on the note.
Sunbelt also said the last of thirteen leases with Pier 1 will expire on June 30.
Sunbelt is a nursery retailer in six major metropolitan areas in Texas, Arizona and California. Its 70 stores sell nursery stock and lawn and garden products.
